business_problem: NHS Shared Business Services needed to replace hundreds of fragmented finance applications and processes with a secure, standardized platform that could support critical national infrastructure, improve efficiency, and help the NHS redirect savings to frontline care.
solution_summary: NHS Shared Business Services redesigned its finance and procurement platform on Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP and Oracle Enterprise Performance Management running in Oracle UK Sovereign Cloud. The environment standardizes accounts payable, receivable, cash management, debt recovery, invoice processing, purchasing, planning, and forecasting across NHS organizations while keeping security posture and data-center location aligned with UK critical-infrastructure requirements. Oracle Integration Cloud and Oracle Analytics Cloud pull data from dozens of systems and exchange it securely through Oracle Autonomous AI Lakehouse, creating a scalable analytics layer for more consistent ways of working across regions and integrated care systems. Quarterly application updates deliver new capabilities continuously, and built-in AI features are being used to reduce repetitive work. Together, the Oracle stack acts as the backbone for one of the NHS's most critical shared-service platforms.
products_used: Oracle Fusion Cloud Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP)

solution_components.name: Oracle Fusion Cloud Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP)
solution_components.role: Runs standardized finance and procurement processes for NHS organizations at shared-service scale.

solution_components.name: Oracle Enterprise Performance Management
solution_components.role: Supports detailed operational planning, forecasting, and insight for NHS finance operations.

solution_components.name: Oracle UK Sovereign Cloud
solution_components.role: Hosts the shared-services platform in a cloud environment aligned with UK national-infrastructure and data requirements.

solution_components.name: Oracle Integration Cloud
solution_components.role: Moves and standardizes data across dozens of NHS and partner systems.

solution_components.name: Oracle Analytics Cloud
solution_components.role: Turns disaggregated operational data into analytics for consistent decision-making across regions.

solution_components.name: Oracle Autonomous AI Lakehouse
solution_components.role: Provides the shared analytics and secure data-exchange layer beneath the finance platform.

data_flow: Transaction, planning, and operational data from dozens of NHS systems flows through Oracle Integration Cloud into Oracle Fusion ERP, Oracle EPM, and Oracle Autonomous AI Lakehouse; Oracle Analytics Cloud then exposes the standardized data for reporting and decision-making across NHS regions and integrated care systems.
business_outcome: NHS Shared Business Services built a scalable national finance platform that standardizes operations, supports critical-infrastructure compliance, processes very large transaction volumes, and gives NHS organizations more insight while freeing time and savings for frontline care.
